fusions.name: Hanging Sip
fusions.desc: Bites the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Roost Shriek
fusions.desc: A shriek that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Heard Through the Thread
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Quiet Tap
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
